name: Noachian-Bastion
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near tidally locked hemisphere.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Approach protocols for pirate hideout are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.

For traders, dark crystals, helium-3, carbon and water alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
